evidence.finding: Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.Mono.android-arm64 10.0.12 THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT section 'License notice for Unicode data' (LF sha256 de4a44cff385b182f0059f797c8131afa1a3934baa6b725d1acb74f778ce47d3); the terms text is the Unicode-3.0 form, copyright 1991-2024 Unicode, Inc.

licence.scope: Verbatim Unicode data section (Unicode-3.0 licence) of the Mono runtime bundle; admitted for the MAUI shipped closure. This record does not admit any implementation.
licence.copyingPermission: Verbatim reproduction of the governing legal document and required notices for licensed distribution; no modification of its operative terms and no implication of trademark endorsement.

attribution: Copyright notices and licence terms as printed in the upstream legal document; see the retained section.

verification.command: Split the pinned legal document at its section headers; compare the LF-normalized section bytes with the target SHA-256 and the target file name.
verification.expected: The retained section is verbatim, after LF normalization, from the pinned legal document.

notice.text: Retain this legal text verbatim with the MAUI Android release notices.
notice.reason: The MAUI Android release notices must carry the Unicode data notice of the Mono runtime bundle (AND.40 unit 5b; decision 20).

review.rationale: Unicode-3.0 terms, admitted as a permissive licence for the MAUI shipped closure; the notice ships in every .NET Android application (AND.40 unit 5b, decision 20).
